title: [Extensibility][SubscriptionBilling] Make procedures necessary for custom Usage Data Connector externally accessible
summary: Subscription Billing procedures for creating custom Usage Data Connectors are now externally accessible by removing internal keyword visibility modifiers.
key_points: Six procedures in UsageDataBilling table made public for custom connector implementations
One procedure in CreateUsageDataBilling codeunit made public
Enables dependent apps to implement custom Usage Data Connector interface
No functional behavior changes to existing Subscription Billing operations
Low risk change affecting only extension points
quote: All necessary procedures for creating billing data are internal and not accessible to a dependent app.
